notes: Beren and Lúthien's last dwelling, in Ossiriand among the Seven Rivers.

“and they passed beyond the River Gelion into Ossiriand, and dwelt there in Tol Galen the green isle, in the midst of Adurant, until all tidings of them ceased.” — The Silmarillion, Of the Ruin of Doriath [C]
in Ossiriand, beyond Gelion — the land the Silmarillion's own index excepts from the drowning: 'only Ossiriand (Lindon) remained'

timeline.cite: Silm 22 [I-M] — the archive's own placement, and the open '+' is doing the honest work. NO ANNAL DATES EITHER: every mention of Tol Galen and Sarn Athrad in HoME XI sits in the map commentary, under no annal year, and Silm 22 prints none. The ambush follows Thingol's death, which the archive places at F.A. c.502
timeline.what: Beren and Lúthien dwell on Tol Galen; the Green-elves aid the ambush at Sarn Athrad

timeline.cite: [I-H] — not stated of the isle itself, but it follows from two: the Silmarillion places it beyond Gelion in Ossiriand (Of the Ruin of Doriath [C]), and the same book's index excepts Ossiriand from the drowning — 'only Ossiriand (Lindon) remained' [C]. WJ Tale of Years [C] for the year: recension A '597 Maidros and Maglor, last surviving sons of Fëanor, seize the Silmarils', recension B '597 This entry was changed to 587', and the same recension's '550–597 ... changed to 545–587' — the two ends of one redating, and the witness behind the owner's ruling of 31 July.
timeline.what: Beleriand went under the sea; this isle lay beyond Gelion in Ossiriand, which remained
